profile.summary: A pediatric hospital in Oakland, part of the UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals, that provides inpatient and outpatient care for children from infancy through young adulthood. It has specialty departments, a pediatric emergency room, an intensive care unit and a Level 1 trauma center.
